source_name: AWS CloudTrail User Guide — Security best practices
source_recommendation_assessment: AWS recommends creating ongoing records using CloudTrail trails, maintaining logging coverage across regions, enabling log file integrity validation, and protecting the completeness and availability of audit logs. This supports keeping audit logging enabled and validating any replacement before retiring a trail. The project-specific pipeline fast-lane implementation is not verified by this source review.
source_version_or_section: Preventative security best practices; preserve audit-log integrity and ongoing records
